title: Finite Extinction and Reverse Bookkeeping
mathematical_role: Represent finite extinction and reverse topological bookkeeping as an explicit staged event graph rather than a disappearing-icon metaphor.
learning_objective: Distinguish geometric evolution and surgery events from the later logical reconstruction of original topology.
literal_semantics: Ricci flow changes metric geometry over time and controlled surgery modifies the evolving description at selected necks.
Under the relevant imported theorem hypotheses, certain components become extinct in finite geometric time.
The controlled event history supports reverse topological bookkeeping in the proof architecture.
nonliteral_semantics: A box disappearing in the event graph is not itself proof of finite extinction.
The schematic does not independently establish geometrization or the Poincare theorem.
